title: Partial Linearity in Categories
summary: In this paper we generalise the notion of linearity (in the sense of Lawvere) to a category C equipped with a compatible sum structure and product structure. In this context, any morphism f from an n-fold sum to an n-fold product has a unique n by m matrix presentation, but a morphism for a given matrix does not necessarily exist. We define the sum and product to be compatible if there exists a natural transformation i from sum to product with matrix presentation the identity and define C to be partially linear if such an i is invertible.
